description: Read-only. Lists what compose_design builds with, one line each: the art-direction guide, twelve starting specs (the owner’s best layouts written as specs, to take whole and vary), faces (with the letters each sets: Latin, Polish, Ukrainian), effects, style recipes, our picture pack by theme (ids for { from: "pack", id }), the template packs and the owner’s best base layouts, and the formats. Call it once before your first spec; `what` narrows it.

what.description: one part (default all): guide = compose_design’s art-direction guide with three example specs, edits = adjust_design’s phrase → edit examples, starters = the twelve starting specs whole; e.g. "starters"
